en.title: Catatan Android
en.summary: An offline-first native Android note-taking application built with Java, SQLite database migration, Storage Access Framework media attachments, live search, and a soft-delete Recycle Bin.
en.description: I built Catatan Android as an offline-first note-taking application on Android using Java and SQLite. It features instant search, category filtering via Material ChipGroup, gallery photo attachments using persistent Storage Access Framework permissions, and a soft-delete Recycle Bin to safely restore deleted notes.
en.problem: Many note-taking apps rely on online sync, introducing privacy risks, slow offline performance, and accidental loss of important notes when deleted.
en.solution: I developed a native Android app using SQLite local storage, persistent Storage Access Framework permissions for image attachments, and a soft-delete mechanism (is_deleted = 1) that lets users recover deleted notes from a dedicated Recycle Bin.
implementation: Designed MVC architecture separating Note model entity, SQLite DatabaseHelper, and RecyclerView adapters.
Implemented SQLite database migration from version 1 to 2, adding soft-delete columns without losing data.
Built soft-delete Recycle Bin workflow allowing users to restore deleted notes or permanently purge records.
Utilized Storage Access Framework with takePersistableUriPermission for attached photo persistence.
Applied Android 13+ granular permission checks based on device API level.
challenges: Maintaining URI media access permissions across device reboots so attached photos stay visible.
Executing smooth SQLite database version migrations without corrupting existing user notes.
results: Achieved 100% offline note creation, live search filtering, and media attachment capability.
Prevented accidental note loss through the soft-delete Recycle Bin recovery system.
Delivered fast sub-30ms SQLite query lookup speeds.
lessons: Soft delete patterns in mobile apps improve user satisfaction by preventing accidental data loss.
Persistable URI permissions are essential when integrating gallery media into local SQLite databases.

id.title: Catatan Android
id.summary: Aplikasi catatan native Android offline-first dengan Java, migrasi database SQLite, lampiran foto via Storage Access Framework, pencarian cepat, dan fitur Sampah (soft-delete).
id.description: Catatan Android saya buat sebagai aplikasi pembuat catatan offline-first di sistem Android menggunakan Java dan SQLite native. Aplikasi ini memiliki pencarian cepat, filter kategori dengan Material ChipGroup, lampiran foto galeri berbasis izin Storage Access Framework yang persisten, serta fitur Sampah (soft-delete) untuk mengembalikan catatan yang tidak sengaja terhapus.
id.problem: Banyak aplikasi catatan yang bergantung pada sinkronisasi cloud, menyebabkan risiko privasi, lambat saat offline, dan data hilang permanen ketika catatan terhapus.
id.solution: Saya membuat aplikasi Android native menggunakan penyimpanan lokal SQLite, izin Storage Access Framework persisten untuk lampiran gambar, dan mekanisme soft-delete yang memungkinkan pengguna mengembalikan catatan dari menu Sampah.
implementation: Menerapkan pola MVC yang memisahkan entitas data catatan, kelas akses SQLite DatabaseHelper, dan adapter RecyclerView.
Melakukan migrasi database SQLite dari versi 1 ke 2 untuk menambahkan kolom soft-delete tanpa menghilangkan data lama.
Membuat alur kerja menu Sampah (soft-delete) sehingga pengguna bisa memulihkan atau menghapus catatan secara permanen.
Menggunakan Storage Access Framework dengan takePersistableUriPermission agar foto yang dilampirkan tetap dapat dibuka setelah aplikasi direstart.
Menyesuaikan pengecekan izin akses media Android 13+ sesuai tingkatan API perangkat.
challenges: Menjaga izin akses URI foto galeri tetap aktif setelah HP direstart.
Menjalankan migrasi versi database SQLite dengan aman tanpa merusak catatan yang sudah tersimpan.
results: 100% pembuatan catatan, pencarian kata kunci, dan penambahan foto bekerja secara offline.
Mencegah catatan terhapus secara tidak sengaja berkat sistem pemulihan di menu Sampah.
Performa pencarian dan pembacaan data di SQLite berjalan sangat cepat.
lessons: Fitur soft-delete sangat penting pada aplikasi mobile untuk memberi rasa aman pada pengguna.
Izin akses URI persisten harus diperhatikan saat mengintegrasikan media galeri ke database SQLite lokal.
